correctness.rationale: For a right regular n-gon prism, support of a Cartesian product separates: w_P(U)=sqrt(1−Z²)w_B(V)+|Z| with Z uniform [-1,1] and planar V uniform S^1. Spherical integration yields E w_P²=(2/3)E w_B²+1/3+(2/3)E w_B. Cauchy perimeter gives E w_B=n/pi for a unit-edge n-gon. Difference body is a regular n-gon if n even and a regular 2n-gon if odd, of radii 1/sin(pi/n) and 1/(2sin(pi/(2n))), respectively; support-square integration on a normal cone yields both exact formulas. Independently integrated 100,000 planar directions for n=3,4,5,6,7, agreeing at 1e−9; these finite checks supplement the analytic all-n derivation. Cube n=4 equals known 1+4/pi.
